decision_rule: Promote a candidate only when dataset, baseline, metric and ontology-dependent hypothesis are all available and auditable. Otherwise defer it; do not infer AI novelty or application utility from examples.

candidates.ontology_hypothesis: criticality, site, supplier, alternative, geography and jurisdiction semantics support integrated vulnerability analysis
